title: CustodyChain Custody Event v1.0
description: One append-only lifecycle event about an evidence item, as submitted to the chaincode. The actor identity, organisation (MSP) and timestamp are NOT client inputs: the chaincode takes them from the transaction's signing certificate and the transaction timestamp. Events are never updated or deleted; corrections are new events that reference the corrected one.

reason.description: Why the event happened (the 'Why' of 5W1H), e.g. court order number, FSL request number.

manifest_sha256.description: REGISTER, DERIVE: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical manifest.

merkle_root.description: REGISTER, DERIVE: salted RFC 6962 Merkle root over the manifest's artefacts.

to_custodian_subject.description: TRANSFER_INITIATE: X.509 subject of the intended receiving custodian.

transfer_ref.description: TRANSFER_ACCEPT/REJECT: tx id of the matching TRANSFER_INITIATE.

seal_ids_observed.description: SEAL, TRANSFER_ACCEPT, RESEAL, VERIFY_IDENTITY: seal numbers read on the package.

seal_intact.description: TRANSFER_ACCEPT, VERIFY_IDENTITY: seal condition on receipt.

child_evidence_id.description: DERIVE: the new item (forensic image, aliquot, extraction, enhanced copy).

score.description: Decimal string, e.g. Hamming distance or RMS in mm.

query_artefact_sha256.description: L1 hashes of the new captures used for the comparison (stored off-chain like any artefact).

attachments_sha256.description: Hashes of documents created by this event (receipt photo, FSL report, court order).

corrects_event_tx.description: CORRECTION: tx id of the event being corrected.
